data.title: 毒蛇 · 晨曦窗纱的蕾丝吊带初醒
data.description: 早晨纯净的初阳照透白色纱幔，散落在整洁的木地板上。毒蛇身着浅粉色蕾丝细吊带真丝睡裙赤足站在窗边，伸展着纤细柔软的腰肢。波浪卷发在晨风中蓬松散落，锁骨处的粉红蕾丝在逆光下泛着温润微芒。她转过身来双手背在身后微微倾身，水汪汪的碧绿眼眸带着清晨独有的软糯与撒娇，道出轻声的早安。
data.action: standing barefoot by sunlit balcony window, stretching arms up in pink lace camisole, bare legs, leaning slightly forward with hands behind back, sweet affectionate smile
data.location: sun-filled luxury apartment bedroom with blowing sheer curtains
data.lighting: radiant morning sunbeams filtering through white drapes creating soft halo
data.mood: sweet heart-melting morning romance, innocent pampered girlfriend charm
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot beside a breezy morning window, Viper stretches in a delicate pink lace silk camisole. Her wavy pink hair catches golden rays as she leans forward with an adoring, tender smile.
data.animaCaption: Viper stretching barefoot by a morning window in a pink lace camisole, smiling sweetly.
